title: Width-21 anomaly: route_boustrophedon + vigenere only, BERLIN-only keyword
hypothesis_summary: Tightening of campaign-001 pack F5-51 (width-21 proponent). F5-51 used three composition templates (vig+col, beau+col, route_boustrophedon+vig) and three keywords (BERLIN, CLOCK, EAST) at width=21. This pack drops the two columnar templates entirely — keeping only route_boustrophedon+vigenere — and narrows the keyword pool to BERLIN alone. The narrowing is motivated structurally: the width-21 vertical-bigram anomaly is a route/grid property of the carved CT, so a route layer is the structurally faithful interpretation, while the columnar interpretation muddles that. Predicted side-effect: ngram floor improvement — a winning candidate must produce a plaintext that scores ngram >= -8 at the same time as a non-trivial crib score. campaign_001_coverage: tightened.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Anomaly E0e: writing K4 at width 21 yields 11 repeated vertical bigrams out of 76; expected for random ~1/6750. Bean 2021 §2.1 (Hannon 2010 / LaTurner 2016 / Kirchner 2003).

composition_templates.rationale: Width-21 boustrophedon route + Vigenere substitution. Route-only because a route layer is the structurally faithful interpretation of a vertical-bigram anomaly; the F5-51 columnar templates are dropped.

constraints: Single keyword (BERLIN), single width (21), single composition (route_boustrophedon + vigenere). Hardest tightening of F5-51 within the route_boustrophedon family.
caveats: campaign_001_coverage: tightened. Strictly narrower than F5-51 (drops 2 of 3 composition templates and 2 of 3 keywords; same width). Distinct mechanism from F5-52 (route_diagonal) and F5-53/54/55 (post-null widths 10/17, columnar).

Predicted side-effect (ngram floor improvement): a winning candidate's plaintext must score ngram >= -8 (i.e., better than the noise floor under English quadgram statistics). If a candidate reaches crib_score >= 12 with ngram_score < -8 the side-effect prediction is FALSIFIED — the candidate is decrypting the cribs to letters but not producing English-shaped plaintext, which under width-21 + Vigenere would indicate the structural commitment is wrong even if a coincidental crib match occurs.

Pack passes if any candidate reaches crib_score >= 18 AND ngram_score >= -8. predeclared success criterion. The ngram floor of -8 is calibrated to the kernel's quadgram noise floor (NOISE=6 / STORE=10 / SIGNAL=18 in crib_score; ngram_score around -8 is 'plausibly English-shaped' in the noise band).

The width-21 anomaly disappears under null extraction (memory/width21_bigram_73char.md). This pack commits to the 'raw-CT, no nulls' interpretation; if width-21 is a stego artifact the pack is structurally wrong from the start.
